result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations manipulating a first-order linear partial differential equation in p for complex functions z, f, g with parameter r (coefficients 8r-2), splitting into real and imaginary parts and introducing sum/difference variables m = g - f, n = g + f.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(2yi-p)+2z(2r-1)-z_1$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial p^2}(2yi-p)[-\pm-]\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(4r+1)-\frac{\partial z_1}{\partial p}\right)i$
$(8r-2)z=g-f$
$(8r-2)\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(2x-p)+z_1\right)=4rg+(4r-2)f$
$(8r-2)z_1=4rg+(4r-2)f+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial g}{\partial p}\right)(2x-p)$
$2\left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial f}{\partial p}\right)(x+yi-p)-2g-4(2r-1)f=G(8r-2)$
$2\left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial f}{\partial p}\right)(x+yi-p)-8rg+2f=F(8r-2)$

$F=F'+\beta i$
$(8r-2)F=[-\pm-]2\left(\frac{\partial g_1}{\partial p_1}+\frac{\partial f_1}{\partial p_1}\right)(x+yi-p_1)+8rg_1+2f_1-2\alpha i+\beta i(8r-2)$
$(8r-2)G=+2\left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial p_1}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial p_1}\right)(x+yi-p_1)-2g_1+4(2r[-+1-])f_1[-+-]4(2r-1)\alpha i$
$g-f=m\quad g+f=n\qquad -(8r-2)g-(8r-6)f$
$4\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}(x+yi-p)-[-(8r-2)m-]4m-(8r-2)n=(8r-2)n_1-(8r-2)\alpha i+\beta i$ [?]
$4\frac{\partial m_1}{\partial p_1}(x+yi-p_1)-4m_1-(8r-2)m_1=(8r-2)\frac{\alpha-\beta i}{2}$ [?] $+(4r)\alpha i$ [?] $=(8r-2)m$

methods.what: Linear first-order differential expression in p for z with substitution (8r-2)z = g - f
Expressing z_1 in terms of f, g and their p-derivatives
Derived equations defining G and F from g, f
Change of variables to difference and sum m = g - f, n = g + f to decouple the system
